mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses equity discount rates by reducing risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in continued monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market health that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0% over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic contraction across construction and manufacturing sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as profit expectations decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% annually) and low interest rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) regimes, the market prices stable growth prospects, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low inflation and low interest rates (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%, FEDFUNDS < 0.5%)
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL is below 2.0% and FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to current spending trends.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) falling below 50,000 indicate labor market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is below 50,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and interest rates (FEDFUNDS) signal disinflationary monetary easing that reduces real interest rates and boosts equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 700,000 units annually) signal strong residential demand that supports construction and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in robust economic activity.
failure_condition: In periods when HOUST exceeds 700,000 units annually, S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
